_readme: Real Census 2021 (as at Census Day, 21 March 2021) Output-Area-level population and household counts for exactly the 15 OAs relevant to Cholsey/Moulsford (same set as P1.4/P1.5's reference data). Retrieved live from the nomis API (nomisweb.co.uk), which republishes ONS Census 2021 topic-summary tables queryable by OA -- see ADR-0005 and the P1.6 worklog entry.

_provenance.title: TS001 - Number of usual residents in households and communal establishments (Census 2021)
_provenance.vintage: Census 2021, as at Census Day 21 March 2021
_provenance.method: nomis API query filtered to the 15 relevant OA21CD codes (measures=20100, i.e. C2021_RESTYPE_3='Total: All usual residents'), summed per parish via the P1.4 OA->parish best-fit lookup.

_provenance.title: TS041 - Number of Households (Census 2021)
_provenance.vintage: Census 2021, as at Census Day 21 March 2021
_provenance.method: nomis API query filtered to the 15 relevant OA21CD codes (measures=20100, 'Number of households'), summed per parish via the P1.4 OA->parish best-fit lookup.
